note: L3 run against the REAL residual from data/fixtures/run_2000 - the payments that L0-L2 matching and L4's deterministic classifier genuinely could not explain. Not a synthetic exercise set. All 6 records independently cross-checked against ground_truth.json by hand (link correctness, category, and amount_at_risk_paise), not just read off this summary's own scores.
defect_confusion_note: compound_fee_tax_error's 4 'misclassified' are FEE_VARIANCE where the generator's own label is UNEXPLAINED_VARIANCE - a defensible-but-imprecise call (the model picked one real anomalous leg as the category rather than the fact that multiple legs are simultaneously unexplained), not a wrong one: the money and the record are correctly surfaced either way. The 1 'missed' (pay_3egKQ6BCralBAI) is a genuinely immaterial 90-paise variance the model judged not worth a separate exception alongside its (correct) settlement match - see benchmarks/sample_traces_live/. One exception (pay_RMejvzSwrh9QXa) reports amount_at_risk_paise=744 for a defect ground truth labels 183 paise: the model cited the largest single unexplained leg (the fee delta) rather than the net bottom-line delta when fee and GST deltas partially offset - same category of imprecision, not a scoring bug.
